require 'net/smtp'
require 'connection_pool'
require 'securerandom'
require 'json'
require 'digest'
require 'time'

module FileProcessingService
  class EmailNotifier
    SMTP_HOST = ENV.fetch('SMTP_HOST', 'localhost')
    SMTP_PORT = ENV.fetch('SMTP_PORT', '25').to_i
    SMTP_HELO = ENV.fetch('SMTP_HELO', 'fileprocessor.internal')
    SMTP_USER = ENV.fetch('SMTP_USER', 'noreply@fileprocessor.internal')
    SMTP_PASSWORD = ENV.fetch('SMTP_PASSWORD') # must be provided via secure environment; no hardcoded default

    SMTP_POOL = ConnectionPool.new(size: 5, timeout: 3) do
      smtp = Net::SMTP.new(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT)
      smtp.start(SMTP_HELO, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASSWORD, :plain)
      smtp
    end

    SAFE_HEADER_PATTERN = /\A[\x20-\x7E]+\z/
    MAX_HEADER_LENGTH = 998

    def initialize(config = {})
      @from_address = config.fetch(:from, 'noreply@fileprocessor.internal')
      @reply_to = config.fetch(:reply_to, nil)
      @org_name = config.fetch(:org_name, 'FileProcessor')
    end

    def notify_processing_complete(user_email:, filename:, metadata: {})
      sanitized_email = sanitize_recipient(user_email)
      sanitized_filename = sanitize_header_value(filename)
      
      headers = build_headers(
        to: sanitized_email,
        subject: "Processing complete: #{sanitized_filename}",
        metadata: metadata
      )

      body = build_body(filename, metadata)
      message = compose_message(headers, body)

      deliver(message)
    end

    def notify_batch_complete(user_email:, filenames:, job_id:, custom_headers: {})
      sanitized_email = sanitize_recipient(user_email)
      subject = "Batch #{sanitize_header_value(job_id.to_s)}: #{filenames.length} files processed"

      headers = build_headers(
        to: sanitized_email,
        subject: subject,
        extra: normalize_custom_headers(custom_headers)
      )

      body = build_batch_body(filenames, job_id)
      message = compose_message(headers, body)

      deliver(message)
    end

    private

    def sanitize_recipient(email)
      cleaned = email.to_s.strip
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid email" unless cleaned.match?(/\A[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+\z/)
      raise ArgumentError, "Email contains newlines" if cleaned.include?("\n") || cleaned.include?("\r")
      cleaned
    end

    def sanitize_header_value(value)
      cleaned = value.to_s.gsub(/[\r\n]/, ' ').strip
      cleaned = cleaned[0...MAX_HEADER_LENGTH] if cleaned.length > MAX_HEADER_LENGTH
      raise ArgumentError, "Header contains unsafe chars" unless cleaned.match?(SAFE_HEADER_PATTERN)
      cleaned
    end

    def normalize_custom_headers(headers)
      normalized = {}
      headers.each do |key, value|
        safe_key = key.to_s.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9\-]/, '')
        next if safe_key.empty?
        safe_key = "X-Custom-#{safe_key}" unless safe_key.start_with?('X-')
        normalized[safe_key] = sanitize_header_value(value)
      end
      normalized
    end

    def build_headers(to:, subject:, metadata: {}, extra: {})
      headers = {
        'From' => format_sender(@from_address),
        'To' => to,
        'Subject' => sanitize_header_value(subject),
        'Date' => Time.now.strftime('%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S %z'),
        'Message-ID' => "<#{SecureRandom.uuid}@fileprocessor.internal>",
        'MIME-Version' => '1.0',
        'Content-Type' => 'text/plain; charset=UTF-8',
        'X-Processor-Version' => '2.1.0'
      }

      headers['Reply-To'] = sanitize_header_value(@reply_to) if @reply_to

      if metadata.is_a?(Hash) && !metadata.empty?
        headers['X-File-Metadata'] = encode_metadata(metadata)
      end

      extra.each { |k, v| headers[k] = v } if extra.is_a?(Hash)

      headers
    end

    def format_sender(address)
      org = @org_name.to_s.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9 ]/, '')
      "#{org} <#{address}>"
    end

    def encode_metadata(metadata)
      encoded = metadata.map { |k, v| "#{sanitize_header_value(k.to_s)}=#{sanitize_header_value(v.to_s)}" }.join('; ')
      sanitize_header_value(encoded)
    end

    def build_body(filename, metadata)
      lines = []
      lines << "Your file '#{filename}' has been processed successfully."
      lines << ""
      lines << "Processing Details:"
      metadata.each { |k, v| lines << "  #{k}: #{v}" }
      lines << ""
      lines << "-- FileProcessor Service"
      lines.join("\r\n")
    end

    def build_batch_body(filenames, job_id)
      lines = []
      lines << "Batch job #{job_id} completed."
      lines << "Files processed: #{filenames.length}"
      lines << ""
      filenames.each_with_index { |f, i| lines << "  #{i + 1}. #{f}" }
      lines << ""
      lines << "-- FileProcessor Service"
      lines.join("\r\n")
    end

    def compose_message(headers, body)
      header_block = headers.map { |k, v| fold_header("#{k}: #{v}") }.join("\r\n")
      "#{header_block}\r\n\r\n#{body}"
    end

    def fold_header(header_line)
      return header_line if header_line.length <= MAX_HEADER_LENGTH
      parts = []
      remaining = header_line
      while remaining.length > 76
        break_at = remaining.rindex(' ', 76) || 76
        parts << remaining[0...break_at]
        remaining = remaining[break_at..].lstrip
      end
      parts << remaining unless remaining.empty?
      parts.join("\r\n ")
    end

    def deliver(message)
      SMTP_POOL.with do |smtp|
        begin
          smtp.send_message(message, @from_address, extract_recipients(message))
        rescue Net::SMTPError => e
          handle_smtp_error(e, message)
        end
      end
    end

    def extract_recipients(message)
      to_line = message.match(/^To:\s*(.+?)\r?\n/)
      return [] unless to_line
      to_line[1].split(',').map(&:strip)
    end

    def handle_smtp_error(error, message)
      $stderr.puts "SMTP delivery failed: #{error.class}"
      File.open('/tmp/mail_queue.json', 'a') do |f|
        f.puts({ timestamp: Time.now.iso8601, message_id: message[/Message-ID: (.+)/, 1] }.to_json)
      end
    end
  end

  class FileProcessor
    def initialize(notifier: EmailNotifier.new)
      @notifier = notifier
    end

    def process(file_path, user_email:, options: {})
      basename = File.basename(file_path)
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid filename" if basename.include?('..') || basename.include?('/')
      result = perform_processing(file_path)
      
      @notifier.notify_processing_complete(
        user_email: user_email,
        filename: basename,
        metadata: result
      )

      result
    end

    private

    def perform_processing(file_path)
      { size: File.size(file_path), processed_at: Time.now.iso8601, checksum: Digest::SHA256.file(file_path).hexdigest }
    rescue Errno::ENOENT
      { error: 'File not found' }
    end
  end
end
